notes: Two adapter-managed public C++ TCK scenarios exercise distinct branches of the pinned §4.13 requirement. The forced-removal case checks one nonempty Federate Resigned callback while the connection remains usable, membership removal, rejoin, and no additional callback after the federate later resigns itself. The separate connection-loss case checks the public Connection Lost callback and that the survivor's federation-member list excludes the lost federate. Connection Lost is not treated as the Federate Resigned callback. These are bounded local-provider witnesses, not exhaustive coverage of every forced-removal cause or independent-provider conformance.
